locations.title: Caliburn Wonder Weapon Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Starting at Round 10, there will be a zombie wearing a helmet on it's head.
- Kill the zombie and pick up the Stamp it drops.
- Bring the stamp to the [Dragon Statue](#loc=954032) and interact with it to receive the Dragon Bastard Sword.
- Interact with the [Dragon Sword Receptacle](#loc=954036) in the Entrance Hall to place the sword inside, causing Cauldrons around the map to light up.
- Head to each Cauldron, grab the fire in it, then bring it to the Dragon Sword Receptacle and interact with it:
   - [Dragon Cauldron](#loc=954033)
   - [Dragon Cauldron](#loc=954034)
   - [Dragon Cauldron](#loc=954035)
- After completing all three, interact with the Receptacle to receive the wonder weapon.

locations.title: Durendal Wonder Weapon Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Starting at Round 10, there will be a zombie wearing a helmet on it's head.
- Kill the zombie and pick up the Stamp it drops.
- Bring the stamp to the [Stag Statue](#loc=954018) and interact with it to receive the Stag Bastard Sword.
- Around the map there are three Lightning Rods that need to be gathered:
   - Head to the Dungeon and a special zombie will now spawn. Kill it and it will drop a [Lightning Rod](#loc=954019).
   - Head to the Upper Village and shoot the [Electrical Box](#loc=954020) using a gun with the Dead Wire Ammo Mod, which will cause the [Lightning Rod](#loc=954021) to drop onto the ground nearby.
   - Head to the Hilltop and pick up the [Lightning Rod](#loc=954022) next to the [Deadshot Daiquiri](#loc=946447) perk machine.
- After acquiring all three, head to the [Pot](#loc=954023) on the west side of the Hillside Ramparts and interact with it.
- A storm will start and zombies will spawn. Survive until lightning strikes the weapon.
- Melee the Pot with the lightning-infused sword three times then place the sword inside in receive the wonder weapon.

locations.title: Balmung Wonder Weapon Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Starting at Round 10, there will be a zombie wearing a helmet on it's head.
- Kill the zombie and pick up the Stamp it drops.
- Bring the stamp to the [Raven Statue](#loc=954025) and interact with it to receive the Raven Bastard Sword.
- Head to the Alchemical Lab and pick up the [Antiquity](#loc=954027) that spawns in a variety of locations in the room.
- Head to the Tavern Cellar and place it on the [Symbol Circle](#loc=954028) on the wall.
- Place the sword inside and, depending on the Antiquity, align the two layers of symbols to the arrow on the bottom:
   - Horn: Aries Zodiac Sign, Normal Triangle
   - Fish: Pisces Zodiac Sign, Upside Down Triangle
   - Jaw: Leo Zodiac Sign, Normal Triangle
   - Skull: Gemini Zodiac Sign, Normal Triangle with a Line
   - Scorpion: Scorpio Zodiac Sign, Upside Down Triangle
- A purple portal will spawn on the ground when successful and orbs will now come out of the Symbol Circle.
- Lead three orbs into the portal then head to the main floor of the tavern to find another portal.
- Lead three orbs into that portal then head upstairs to find the final portal.
- Lead three into there then interact with the Symbol Circle to acquire the wonder weapon.

locations.title: Solais Wonder Weapon Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Starting at Round 10, there will be a zombie wearing a helmet on it's head.
- Kill the zombie and pick up the Stamp it drops.
- Bring the stamp to the [Lion Statue](#loc=954030) and interact with it to receive the Lion Bastard Sword.
- Special glowing parasites will now start spawning with regular zombies.
- Head to the Upper Village and kill one of the parasites, causing the sword to glow.
- Hit the [Lion Door](#loc=954031) with the sword to spawn a symbol on the door.
- Doing this four times will allow you to interact with the door, spawning you in a small corridor.
- A pedestal will appear in the center of the room. Place the sword inside the pedestal.
- The sides of the pedestal will glow and small symbols will appear around the room on the walls and ceiling.
- Shoot the symbols in the correct order from what appears on the pedestal then interact with the sword to acquire the wonder weapon.

locations.title: Citadelle des Morts Main Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- After turning on the Pack-A-Punch, interact with [Krafft's Cell](#loc=954007) and speak with Gabriel Krafft.
- Head to the Sitting Rooms and there will be four torn page fragments scattered around to collect.
- After collecting all four, acquire [Melee Macchiato](#loc=946461) and punch the wall in front of the [Wall of Symbols](#loc=954008).
- Head to the Tavern and six bottle will be around on the tables and shelves:
   - [I Bottle](#loc=954011)
   - [II Bottle](#loc=954010)
   - [III Bottle](#loc=954012)
   - [IV Bottle](#loc=954013)
   - [V Bottle](#loc=954014)
   - [VI Bottle](#loc=954009)
- Interacting with each one will reveal a symbol. Shoot the symbols, in order, on the wall.
- Once done, the wall next to the Symbols will open up, revealing the [Book](#loc=954015).
- Place the torn page fragments onto the book to reveal four symbols.
- Each symbol corresponds to one of the [Point of Power Traps](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-black-ops-6/maps/zombies-citadelle-des-morts?search=point_of_power_trap%20%26%26%20category%3A27396) around the map, corresponding to the symbol that is on the ground at the trap.
- Activate each trap and kill zombies quickly to turn the symbol gray in the book. This will need to be done for each symbol in the order of symbols from top-left, bottom-left, top-right, then bottom-right.
- Next, acquire each of the wonder weapons by doing each of their easter eggs:
   - [Caliburn Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=954002)
   - [Durendal Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=954003)
   - [Balmung Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=954004)
   - [Solais Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=954005)
- After all are acquired, there are four incantations that need to be gathered, using the wonder weapons:
   - Dark Incantation:
      - Head to the Oubliette Room and take the [Cave Slide](#loc=946494).
      - While sliding, shoot the [Raven](#loc=954037) that is perched on top of a rock.
      - It will now appear flying above the Town Square. Shoot it again and pick up the [Raven's Talon](#loc=954038) it drops.
      - Bring it to the [Raven Ritual Location](#loc=954039) in the Undercroft, place it, and fill it with souls by killing zombies nearby.
      - After it is filled enough, a chest will spawn. Melee the chest using [Balmung](#loc=954042) to receive the Dark Incantation.
   - Light Incantation:
      - Head to the Dining Hall and shoot the Crystal above the [Vulture Aid](#loc=946480) perk machine.
      - Redirect the Crystal so the beam of light its emitting hits the next crystal.
      - Keep aligning the crystals until the beam of light shines on the bust on the table in the Alchemical Lab.
      - Pick up the [Paladin's Brooch](#loc=954045) that has now appeared in front of the bust.
       - Bring it to the [Lion Ritual Location](#loc=954046) in the Dining Hall, place it, and fill it with souls by killing zombies nearby.
      - After it is filled enough, a chest will spawn. Melee the chest using [Solais](#loc=954043) to receive the Light Incantation.
   - Fire Incantation:
      - Around the outer part of the castle are three sets of bonfires:
         - [Bonfire](#loc=954048)
         - [Bonfire](#loc=954049)
         - [Bonfire](#loc=954050)
      - Light all three of them with a fire grenade or weapon.
      - Once the third one is lit, a Doppleghast will spawn. Killing it will drop the [Ra's Ankh](#loc=954051).
      - Bring it to the [Dragon Ritual Location](#loc=954052) in the Courtyard, place it, and fill it with souls by killing zombies nearby.
      - After it is filled enough, a chest will spawn. Melee the chest using [Caliburn](#loc=954040) to receive the Fire Incantation.
   - Electric Incantation:
      - Head to the Hillside and go inside the barn.
      - Shoot down the horseshoe inside and pick up [Otto's Horsehoe](#loc=954053).
      - Head to the [Rampart Cannon](#loc=946465) and shoot yourself out of it.
      - On the ground somewhere on the map, the [Pegasus' Horseshoe](#loc=954054) can be found to be picked up, indicated by lightning continuously striking it.
       - Bring it to the [Stag Ritual Location](#loc=954055) in the Courtyard, place it, and fill it with souls by killing zombies nearby.
      - After it is filled enough, a chest will spawn. Melee the chest using [Durendal](#loc=954041) to receive the Electric Incantation.
- After collecting all four incantations, head to the [Code Wall](#loc=954056) that appears after completing the trap step.
- In the order of the wall, pick up the corresponding sword, use the corresponding incantation on the Statue for that sword, then inspect the sword.
- Once done for all four statues in the correct order, interact and pick up the [Mystic Orb](#loc=954057).
- The Mystic Orb will be needed to place in four different places around the map and filled with souls with zombies killed with a corresponding type of damage (Except for the Light Orb Holder, which will require picking up green orbs that spawn around the area to fill):
   - [Fire Orb Holder](#loc=954058)
   - [Electric Orb Holder](#loc=954059)
   - [Light Orb Holder](#loc=954060)
   - [Void Orb Holder](#loc=954061)
- Once the Orb is charged with all four elements, place it into the Code Wall to unlock a secret room.
- Interact with the recording on the table, then pick up the [Guardian Key](#loc=954062).
- Head to the Town Square and place it at the hole underneath the statue. interact with it again to start the boss fight.

locations.title: Rampart Cannon Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- After opening the door to the castle, the [Rampart Cannon](#loc=946465) will now shoot into the Town Square.
- To get it to be able to launch into the Dining Hall instead, there are two items on the map that need to be gathered:
   - [Gear](#loc=954528)
   - [Blow Torch](#loc=954527)
- This will then allow you to crank the Rampart Cannon back at the Castle.

locations.title: Free Peeks Perk Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Around the map, Mr. Peeks can be seen dancing in very specific spots. Head to each one and shoot him in order:
   1. [Mr. Peeks](#loc=954530)
   2. [Mr. Peeks](#loc=954531)
   3. [Mr. Peeks](#loc=954532)
- After, head down to the Dungeon and shoot [Mr. Peeks](#loc=954533) one final time to receive a random free perk.

locations.title: Bartender Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

   - [Liquor Bottle](#loc=954535)
   - [Liquor Bottle](#loc=954536)
   - [Liquor Bottle](#loc=954537)
- Head to the Tavern and, behind the bar, interact with the bottle.
- Zombies will arrive and order a specific drink. Once complete, you'll receive a free PHD Flopper.

locations.title: Pool Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

locations.title: Caliburn Song Easter Egg
locations.description:

   - [Dragon Cauldron](#loc=954034)
   - [Dragon Cauldron](#loc=954035)

locations.title: Incantation Wall Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- After getting all four Wonder Weapons and acquiring all four incantations, head back to the [Wall of Symbols](#loc=954008) in the Undercroft.
- Use each incantation on the Wall of Symbols to initiate a lockdown.
- After completing three waves of zombies, various loot will drop onto the ground.

locations.title: Maya & Franco Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- As Maya, survive to round 12 or higher and interact with the [Radio](#loc=954543) in the Dining Hall.
- After the dialogue, interact with the door next to it and head down the hallway.
- Kill Vermin until a HVT spawns then pick up the key it drops.
- Interact with the door at the end to play a cutscene and receive a variety of loot and a legendary GS45.

locations.title: Fire Wisp Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Around the map are four fireplaces:
   - [Fireplace](#loc=954545)
   - [Fireplace](#loc=954546)
   - [Fireplace](#loc=954547)
   - [Fireplace](#loc=954548)
- Light each one in quick succession to spawn fire wisps that will track down and kill zombies.
   - This can be done multiple times in one game.

locations.title: Essence Well Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- In the Village Ascent, there is a [Well](#loc=954551) in the middle of the courtyard.
- Throw a frag grenade down the well to spawn in vermin and a variety of essence.
- The well can now act as a small bank, as interacting with it will place essence inside.
- Throw another grenade down the well to withdraw the essence placed inside.

locations.title: Rat Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, grab the [Cheese Wheel](#loc=954552) from the Town Square.
- Then, there will be Rats appearing around the map:
   - [Rat](#loc=954553)
   - [Rat](#loc=954554)
   - [Rat](#loc=954555)
   - [Rat](#loc=954556)
   - [Rat](#loc=954557)
   - [Rat](#loc=954558)
   - [Rat](#loc=954559)
   - [Rat](#loc=954560)
   - [Rat](#loc=954561)
   - [Rat](#loc=954562)
- Stand close to the rats to scare them away.
- Head to the [Rat Plate](#loc=954563) to feed the rats that you've scared.
- Interact with the plate to place down the cheese wheel, giving loot depending on how many rats are fed.
   - If all ten rats are fed, a cosmetic crown will also spawn.

locations.title: Chess Piece Easter Egg
locations.description:

   - [Knight Piece](#loc=954586)
- Head to the [Chess Board](#loc=954582) and place it down.
- Kill zombies within the circle to spawn a large Knight Chess Piece which will follow you and kill zombies.
